data.body: Landed as Gerrit change 1101 (merged: 262616961, LLM-Review +1 / Verified +1 on the extended patchset 2). Coverage per operator scope: ALL review workflows and passes run at the resolved model's maximum output budget — plan review (Pass-1 chunks/AGENT/container/ISF/summarizer/prerequisite, Pass-2 verify both arms + completion sub-call, Pass-4 coach), four-pass code review (base, overlays, verify, coach — inherited by the Gerrit review-bot), completion verifier primary call, and review_ticket. Mechanism: MODEL_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS table beside sizing.largest_window_tokens (haiku 64k, sonnet/opus 128k, unknown -> 16k default) — ModelProfile seam was unavailable on main and lacks max-output; 'output_budget: model_max' with-input for workflow steps; bounded-recovery output_token_limit clamps untouched; SDK streaming guard verified inert (explicit per-request timeout). Output remains bounded by actual findings per the operator's rationale: unspent max_tokens bills nothing, truncation billed a full re-review or lost findings. Tests: tests/unit/workflow/test_review_output_budget.py asserting request budgets per workflow and per pass.
